name: Tenshi no Oshigoto -Their Wishes Afterward-
original_name: 天使のお仕事 -Their Wishes Afterward-
source: A continuation of Shiori Misaka's storyline in Kanon. It expands on their relationship as they attempt to figure out what happened to Ayu Tsukimiya.
